definitions.explanation: Physically soft and bendable, or mentally adaptable and open to change. Used for both physical flexibility of the body or materials, and figurative flexibility in thinking, planning, or attitude.

examples.japanese: {柔軟|じゅうなん}な{体|からだ}。
{柔軟|じゅうなん}な{考|かんが}え{方|かた}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: A flexible way of thinking is important.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{状況|じょうきょう}に{応|おう}じて{柔軟|じゅうなん}に{対応|たいおう}できる{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: He is someone who can respond flexibly depending on the situation.

notes:
Na-adjective describing physical or mental flexibility.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {柔軟|じゅうなん}に
- Noun form: {柔軟|じゅうなん}さ (flexibility), {柔軟性|じゅうなんせい} (flexibility as a quality)

CONJUGATION:
- Negative: {柔軟|じゅうなん}ではない
- Te-form: {柔軟|じゅうなん}で
- Past: {柔軟|じゅうなん}だった

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {柔軟|じゅうなん}な{発想|はっそう} (flexible thinking)
- {柔軟|じゅうなん}な{姿勢|しせい} (flexible attitude)
- {柔軟|じゅうなん}に{対応|たいおう}する (to deal with flexibly)
- {柔軟|じゅうなん}{体操|たいそう} (stretching exercises)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {柔|やわ}らかい: soft to the touch, gentle — focuses on physical texture
- {柔軟|じゅうなん}: flexible, adaptable — emphasizes ability to bend or adjust
